summary: ARTFUL iteration 2 — validated NEW features: verified-buyer reviews (submit + admin approve + duplicate block), customer cancel-order flow, order timeline UI + payment-status badge, hero trust badges, Festive Sale campaign bar+CTA, About/Our Story/Contact pages, admin Refunds page, admin Campaigns page, admin image UPLOAD widget (replacing URL text fields) with Emergent object storage round-trip, plus regression on guest checkout COD. 8/8 new-feature backend pytest cases pass; all new frontend testids and flows verified end-to-end.

backend_endpoints_tested: GET /api/cms/active-campaign (returns active promotion after admin create)
POST /api/products/{slug}/reviews (403 without purchase, 200 after COD order, 400 on duplicate)
frontend_flows_tested: Home: hero-trust-badges shows 1000+ / 100% / Best Quality / Fastest Delivery / 4.5
Home: campaign-bar + campaign-cta rendered (Festive Sale live countdown)
Footer social icons (Instagram/FB/Twitter) rendered in bottom bar
/admin/products Add Product modal uses upload-btn-product-images + hidden file input upload-product-images (no URL textbox for images)
Guest COD checkout end-to-end: addr-name/line1/city/state/pincode -> payment-cod -> place-order-btn -> /order-success/ART-2026-00014
OrderDetail: order-timeline + order-payment-status ('Cash on Delivery') + cancel-order-btn visible
PDP after purchase: write-review-box + rv-star-5 + rv-title + rv-body + rv-submit works; thank-you/pending message shown
Cancel Order -> success toast 'Your order has been cancelled.' -> status becomes Cancelled -> cancel-order-btn hidden

critical_code_review_comments: test_artful_api.py (previous iteration file) has 1 failure + 6 errors caused by Razorpay now being enabled (dev_mode flipped from True to False, and order_created fixture assumed mock-pay). This is stale test scaffolding — recommend main agent update that file to branch on razorpay_enabled or use COD in the fixture. Not a product bug.
routers_admin.py::create_refund silently caps amount at order total (min(amount, total)) without warning — consider returning a hint if the requested amount exceeds the order total.

routers_shop.py::cancel_order restocks BOTH stock and reserved only for prepaid; for cash-on-delivery (payment.status == 'cod_confirmed') it also treats as paid and restocks stock (correct). But cod_confirmed cancel does NOT create a refund row (also correct, no money captured). Behaviour aligns with spec.
Frontend footer: text-only fallback for social handles is absent (icons only). Fine for design, but a11y-wise consider aria-label on each anchor (looks like it is present in code — verify).
Prev-iteration doc referenced login-btn for admin; actual testid is admin-login-btn. Aligning spec avoids future testing loops.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@artful.com / Artful@2026. Customer via DEV OTP (POST /api/auth/otp/send returns dev_otp).

rca of the issue: No product bugs found. Prior test file failures are environment drift (Razorpay flipped to enabled) not a regression.
